patterns.message: shared/ has been removed. Each frame owns its own components, types, hooks, and utilities — copy the implementation into this frame instead of reintroducing a shared module. (Cross-unit imports are a separate invariant, owned by test/deployment-unit-boundaries.test.ts — this rule only stops a shared/ directory coming back.)

Import from `react-aria-components` only. These packages are its internals — `react-aria-components` pulls `react-aria` 3.51.0 and `react-stately` 3.49.0 in itself and imports them at ~790 sites — and this unit declares none of them, so a direct import also depends on a package its package.json does not list. If a react-aria-components API genuinely requires one of these as a value type (@internationalized/date for the date components is the known case), that is a decision to record in docs/design/ui-shell-contract.md §3a, not to work around here.
